name: Gemini Daily Brief
desc: Personalized daily overview inside the Gemini app
desc_zh: Gemini 应用里汇总当天要事的每日简报
solves: Mornings start with checking a dozen apps; Daily Brief pulls priorities from connected apps and chats into one view.
solves_zh: 早上要逐个查看十几个应用，Daily Brief 把关联应用和对话里的要事汇成一份。
best_for: You open your laptop at nine and want the day's must-dos in one screen first.
best_for_zh: 九点打开电脑，想先在一屏里看完今天必须处理的事。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://gemini.google/release-notes (official Gemini Apps release updates)）。 Entry dated 2026.05.19; Google AI subscribers (18+) in the US. Powered by Personal Intelligence.
